sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.notes: Foundational Transformer paper; predates current chat post-training, long-context, and serving practice and is not product-behavior evidence.

sources.title: SentencePiece: A simple and language independent subword tokenizer and detokenizer for Neural Text Processing
sources.notes: One tokenizer family; consequences depend on the model's actual training tokenizer and template.

sources.title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units
sources.notes: Early machine-translation BPE study; not a universal tokenizer prescription or product-quality result.

sources.title: Model optimization
sources.notes: Provider-specific living guidance used for its evaluate-improve loop, not API permanence or universal process authority.

sources.title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
sources.notes: Broad benchmark framework whose scenarios and models age; task-specific product release evidence remains necessary.

sources.title: Working with evals
sources.notes: Provider-specific evaluation implementation; datasets and regression loops are expressed provider-neutrally in this book.

sources.title: Define success criteria and build evaluations
sources.notes: Provider guidance; criteria and evaluation methods need consequence-specific validation and cannot prove complete coverage.

sources.title: Writing a chat template
sources.notes: Implementation guide; the correct template is model-specific and must match training format.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.notes: Position findings vary by task and model; current candidates require fresh testing and the paper is not a universal ordering rule.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
sources.notes: Original RAG formulation and benchmark setup; reported results do not transfer automatically to current stacks or Mosaic Desk.

sources.title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
sources.notes: Automated RAG metrics and evaluator models require calibration; metric labels do not prove ground truth or authority.

sources.title: Aya Model: An Instruction Finetuned Open-Access Multilingual Language Model
sources.notes: Reported multilingual coverage and results do not establish equal capability across languages or transfer to Mosaic Desk.

sources.title: Tülu 3: Pushing Frontiers in Open Language Model Post-Training
sources.notes: One open-model recipe and evaluation suite; methods and results require reproduction for a target base model and task.

sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
sources.notes: One adaptation method; reported efficiency and quality are model and task dependent and do not select a Mosaic method.

sources.title: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods
sources.notes: Implementation catalog; not all methods support all models, layers, quantization, or hotswap paths.

sources.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
sources.notes: Hardware, model, optimizer, and evaluation assumptions bound the reported efficiency and quality.

sources.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
sources.notes: Method assumptions and comparisons are task and model dependent; preference data encode values and biases.

sources.title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
sources.notes: Foundational general method; modern generative distillation has additional data, decoding, and evaluation concerns.

sources.title: Don't Stop Pretraining: Adapt Language Models to Domains and Tasks
sources.notes: Pre-generative encoder-oriented experiments; useful for the decision, not a promise of modern LLM gains.

sources.title: Automatic Mixed Precision
sources.notes: Operator and hardware support and numerical behavior vary; behavior evaluation remains required.

sources.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
sources.notes: Kernel and hardware implementation concerns are adjacent depth; reported speedups depend on workload and platform.

sources.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
sources.notes: One model family and pipeline; human preference is not identical to truth, safety, or task success.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: Voluntary cross-sector guidance; does not prove compliance, safety, or formal approval.

sources.title: Dolma: an Open Corpus of Three Trillion Tokens for Language Model Pretraining Research
sources.notes: Pretraining corpus at large scale; task-specific post-training recipes need different sampling and rights review.

sources.title: Deduplicating Training Data Makes Language Models Better
sources.notes: Results are corpus, model, and regime dependent; thresholds create tradeoffs and can remove legitimate repetition.

sources.title: Datasheets for Datasets
sources.notes: Documentation framework, not proof that a dataset is representative, lawful, or safe.

sources.title: Self-Instruct: Aligning Language Models with Self-Generated Instructions
sources.notes: Synthetic generation can reproduce model biases and errors; filtering and independent evaluation are mandatory.

sources.title: SFT Trainer
sources.notes: Library APIs and defaults are volatile; a trainer cannot validate the data recipe or behavior claim.

sources.title: Adversarial Machine Learning: A Taxonomy and Terminology of Attacks and Mitigations
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: Taxonomy and guidance, not a guarantee that mitigations are sufficient for a specific system.

sources.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
sources.notes: Agreement results are judge and task specific; human preference is not universal correctness.

sources.title: RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Language Modeling
sources.notes: Benchmark and reward-model population are bounded; leaderboard rank is not a release decision.

sources.title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
sources.notes: General optimizer method; stability and hyperparameters remain workload specific.

sources.title: FullyShardedDataParallel
sources.notes: API semantics are versioned; generalized distributed infrastructure remains adjacent-role depth.

sources.title: Safety best practices
sources.notes: Provider guidance and tools do not establish sufficient controls or approval for a specific consequence.

sources.title: Evaluate a judge model
sources.notes: Managed implementation details are volatile; human ratings and judge calibration retain limitations.

sources.title: G-Eval: NLG Evaluation using GPT-4 with Better Human Alignment
sources.notes: Selected NLG tasks and evaluator model; does not establish evaluator independence or domain authority.

sources.title: Graders
sources.notes: Provider implementation; grader correctness and calibration remain an evidence burden.

sources.title: DPO Trainer
sources.notes: Library API and supported combinations change; it is a versioned implementation example, not outcome evidence.

sources.title: Bitsandbytes quantization
sources.notes: Library and hardware support are volatile; reduced precision requires behavior and resource measurement.

sources.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
sources.notes: Pretraining research, not task-specific post-training evidence.

sources.title: Structured outputs
sources.notes: API and model dependent.

sources.title: DistilBERT, a distilled version of BERT
sources.notes: Encoder study, not decoder-LLM proof.

sources.title: Model Cards for Model Reporting
sources.notes: Documentation cannot establish fitness or approval alone.

sources.title: Safetensors
sources.notes: Format does not establish provenance or trust.

sources.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
sources.notes: Results are hardware, model, workload, and version specific.

sources.title: Accelerating Large Language Model Decoding with Speculative Sampling
sources.notes: Benefit is pairing and workload specific.

sources.title: Quantization in TensorRT-LLM
sources.notes: Hardware/runtime support is volatile.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM Benchmarking
sources.notes: Configuration and hardware must be recorded.

sources.title: vLLM documentation
sources.notes: Fast-moving implementation; pin a tested version.
